_format: Simplified to 3 statuses. Burn = DoT, Brittle = +incoming dmg, Drained = -atk/spd, Stun = skip next ability (chance). Each has a clear role with no overlap.

burn.name: Fevering
burn.desc: Loses 8% max hp per round for 2 rounds.

brittle.name: Brittle
brittle.desc: Takes +30% damage from all sources for 2 rounds.

drained.name: Drained
drained.desc: Attack and speed reduced 30% for 2 rounds.

stun.name: Stunned
stun.desc: 50% chance to skip next ability. Consumed on skip or after 1 round.
